files.handbook/certificates.md:
# Certificates

A certificate is issued to learners who attend at least 80% of sessions and pass the final assessment. Learners below 60% attendance are withdrawn from the cohort.
files.handbook/fees.md: Fees are due 14 days before the cohort starts.

turns.prompt: What attendance do I need to get the course certificate?
